def get_span(arr, start_idx, max_diff):
    count = 1
    for j in range(start_idx + 1, len(arr)):
        if arr[j] - arr[start_idx] > max_diff:
            break
        count += 1
    return count

def main():
    data = []
    n = int(input())
    for _ in range(n):
        val = int(input())
        data.append(val)
    t = int(input())
    data.sort()
    max_count = 0
    for i in range(len(data)):
        span_len = get_span(data, i, t)
        if span_len > max_count:
            max_count = span_len
    print(max_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
